blocks.text: The Argentine side of Iguazu Falls

provenance.rationale: Condense the confirmed Word excursion to the Argentine side into a day heading.

blocks.text:
A guided excursion to the Argentine side of the falls.

From the hotel, the route crosses the Tancredo Neves Bridge. After entering the national park, follow its purpose-built paths and walkways.

On the Argentine side, you can get closer to the water and see the cascades from several levels. Viewpoints stand above the torrents and alongside them, bringing you close to the force of the falling water.

The main stop is the Devil’s Throat, the largest waterfall in the complex. Rainbows often appear over the cascades, surrounded by the natural landscapes of the national park.

The park covers 55,500 hectares and protects the region’s characteristic flora and fauna.

blocks.text:
Breakfast. Transfer to the airport and flight from Iguazu to Rio de Janeiro. A driver meets you at Rio airport and takes you to Búzios.

On arrival, check in at your hotel on the tropical coast, where you will spend the next 3 nights.
